title: Jan jiwat nina naktäwin uñjiripa
intro: Mä chimpux jan uñjat chiqan juk’amp axsarat chiqan umbral ukan sayt’atawa, mä deber ukar katuyatawa, janiw yaqha jaqix munkiti. Kunapachatï tʼaqhesit almanakajj khuyaptʼayasiñatak arnaqasipki ukhajja, mä qhoru jaysäwiw nina cuartonak taypin istʼasi. ¿Aka wiñay uñjirix khitïnsa uk qhanañchtʼasmati?
clues: Nayax mä axsarkañ chiqan jan uñjkañ mutuyañ utar mantañ chiqan sayt'atätwa.
Mä nina nakhaskir, jan jistʼantañjam ninajj nayan jachʼa lurañajajj wali wakiskiriwa.
T’aqhisit almanakax sutijaruw art’apxi, jan tukuskir t’aqhisiñanakapat qhispiyasiñataki.
Kunawsatix achikt’asipki ukhax nayax yatiytwa janiw sarxapxaniti, janipuniw.
Nayax janiw jaqikti, janirakiw jinn — Nayax q’uma ist’asir lurat jaqitwa.
Nayajj Infiernon wiñay uñjirit uttʼayat jilïr angelatwa.

verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
